observed.caption: A sunny urban park with a lake, pedal boats, a green footbridge, and tall city buildings behind palm trees.
observed.description: The foreground shows a calm brownish lake with two small pedal boats carrying people, one with a green canopy, bordered by grassy banks edged with stone where numerous people are sitting, standing, and walking. A green metal pedestrian bridge crosses the water on the right with people on it. Behind the banks are scattered trees including a prominent cluster of tall slender palm trees in the center and dense leafy green trees on the right, plus brown giraffe-shaped sculptures near trees on the left. In the background a modern high-rise building with blue glass and gold accents rises behind a smaller beige clock-tower building, with a light-colored elevated roadway visible behind the trees under a bright blue sky with light clouds.
